All rights reserved. business@angelcreations support@angelcreations.in Terms of Service Privacy Policy We are One – Stop solution for your business Growth We think design forward We see design as a lens to help looking onwards Who we are Angel Creations is an India based Creative Studio, with the mission of building value through design and development. Although we are Indian based Studio but has completed many projects globally. We deal with a diverse selection of clients, small or big companies and organizations, delivering solutions rooted in usability, creativity, aesthetics and craft. We believe in work that comes from collaborations, joint ambition and mutual respect. We use design to make a positive impact for our customer and our surrounding, generating results that are progressive, enduring and engaging. Capabilities Metaverse Virtual Worlds Marketing & Branding Gaming Entertainment Virtual Marketplaces Virtual Economy Virtual Education Virtual Workspaces Virtual events platforms Virtual product showcase Virtual Reality VR Video conferencing VR Content Development VR Gaming VR Training & Simulation VR Education VR for Marketing & Branding VR Architectural Visualization VR Healthcare Applications VR Streaming & Broadcasting VR Equipment Rental & Sales Augment Reality AR Industrial Applications AR Tourism & Travel AR Navigation AR Retail AR Marketing AR Gaming AR Education AR Healthcare AR Entertainment AR Art & Creativity Mixed Reality MR Content Creation MR Training & Education MR Entertainment MR Gaming MR Marketing & Branding MR Architecture & Design MR Remote Collaboration MR Design & Architecture MR Retail MR Media Animation Concept Development Pre-visualization 2D Animation 3D Animation Motion Graphics Visual Effects (VFX) Character Animation Interactive Animations Animated Explainer Videos AR Animation Media Production Video Production Film Production Television Production Animation Production Photography Services Live Event Production Audio Production Post-Production Services Scriptwriting and Storyboarding Media Consulting We're all around Braintree, UK Jaipur, IN Even in these times, our culture strongly stands for true global commuters. Different cultures, languages and landscapes trigger our work. That’s why we love airports. It’s a hub with all those lines going to far different points. Not in one single direction, but various. We pack light and quick and we’re ready to fly anywhere. Which means that we’re not stuck in a given address. But being all over the place. That’s not the future of work. That’s our reality. We build our teams around the projects, not the other way round. The makeup of the team is crucial. It’s the difference between good and great. At Angel Creations we understand that a deeply personal passion piece needs a different set of skills from, say, a vast-scale multicam stunt. And so, Angel Creations is home to a range of talents, from directors of projects and sound-people to graphic designers, animators, event experts and editors, each with many years’ experience in their specialist fields. It means we cherry pick our teams specifically for each project, and purely based on the needs of the client. h6: Privacy Policy for Angel Creations – A Creative Studio
Last Updated: 03/07/2023

This Privacy Policy describes how Angel Creations – A Creative Studio (“we,” “our,” or “us”) collects, uses, and shares personal information when you visit our website, access our services, or interact with our digital platforms. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. By using our website and services, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
1. Information We Collect:

1.1 Personal Information: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you interact with our website, register for an account, or use our services. This may include your name, email address, contact information, username, and any other information you choose to provide.

1.2 Usage Information: We automatically collect certain information about your usage of our website and services. This may include your IP address, device information, browser type, operating system, referring URLs, pages visited, and the dates and times of your interactions.

1.3 Cookies and Tracking Technologies: We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your browsing activities. These technologies help us analyze trends, track user movements, and improve our services. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, although this may affect certain functionalities of our website.
2. How We Use Your Information:

2.1 Provide and Improve our Services: We use your personal information to deliver our services, process transactions, and fulfill your requests. This includes creating and managing your user account, communicating with you, and providing customer support. We may also use the information to improve our website, customize your user experience, and develop new features.

2.2 Communication: We may use your contact information to send you important updates, newsletters, marketing materials, and promotional offers related to our services. You can opt-out of receiving promotional communications by following the instructions provided in the communication or by contacting us directly.

2.3 Analytics and Research: We may analyze the information collected to better understand user preferences, interests, and behaviors. This analysis helps us improve our services, tailor our content, and enhance the user experience. We may use third-party analytics tools to assist us in this process, but your personal information will remain confidential.

2.4 Legal Compliance and Protection: We may use your information to comply with applicable laws, regulations, or legal processes. We may also use or disclose your information to protect the rights, property, or safety of our company, our users, or others, as required or permitted by law.
3. Information Sharing and Disclosure:

3.1 Third-Party Service Providers: We may engage trusted third-party service providers to assist us in delivering our services, analyzing data, processing payments, or hosting our website. These providers are obligated to maintain the confidentiality and security of your personal information and are restricted from using it for any other purpose.

3.2 Business Transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our company assets, your personal information may be transferred as part of the transaction. We will notify you of any such change and provide you with choices regarding your information.
3.3 Legal Requirements: We may disclose your personal information if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g., a court or government agency).
4. Data Security:

We implement reasonable security measures to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of your personal information. However, please note that no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure. We cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.
5. Children’s Privacy:
Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect

personal information from children without appropriate parental consent. If you believe we may have collected information from a child without parental consent, please contact us, and we will promptly remove the information.
6. International Data Transfers:

If you are accessing our services from outside the [country where the company is based], please be aware that your personal information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in [country where the company is based]. By using our services, you consent to the transfer and processing of your information in [country where the company is based].
7. Your Rights and Choices:

You have the right to access, update, correct, and delete your personal information. You may also have the right to restrict or object to the processing of your information and to receive a copy of your information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format. To exercise these rights or for any privacy-related inquiries, please contact us using the information provided below.
8. Changes to this Privacy Policy:

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal obligations. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated Privacy Policy on our website and updating the “Last Updated” date at the top. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically.
9. Contact Us:
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at support@angelcreations.in.

By using our website and services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information as described herein.

h6: Privacy Policy for Angel Creations – A Creative Studio
Last Updated: 03/07/2023

This Privacy Policy describes how Angel Creations – A Creative Studio (“we,” “our,” or “us”) collects, uses, and shares personal information when you visit our website, access our services, or interact with our digital platforms. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. By using our website and services, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
1. Information We Collect:

1.1 Personal Information: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you interact with our website, register for an account, or use our services. This may include your name, email address, contact information, username, and any other information you choose to provide.

1.2 Usage Information: We automatically collect certain information about your usage of our website and services. This may include your IP address, device information, browser type, operating system, referring URLs, pages visited, and the dates and times of your interactions.

1.3 Cookies and Tracking Technologies: We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your browsing activities. These technologies help us analyze trends, track user movements, and improve our services. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, although this may affect certain functionalities of our website.
2. How We Use Your Information:

2.1 Provide and Improve our Services: We use your personal information to deliver our services, process transactions, and fulfill your requests. This includes creating and managing your user account, communicating with you, and providing customer support. We may also use the information to improve our website, customize your user experience, and develop new features.

2.2 Communication: We may use your contact information to send you important updates, newsletters, marketing materials, and promotional offers related to our services. You can opt-out of receiving promotional communications by following the instructions provided in the communication or by contacting us directly.

2.3 Analytics and Research: We may analyze the information collected to better understand user preferences, interests, and behaviors. This analysis helps us improve our services, tailor our content, and enhance the user experience. We may use third-party analytics tools to assist us in this process, but your personal information will remain confidential.

2.4 Legal Compliance and Protection: We may use your information to comply with applicable laws, regulations, or legal processes. We may also use or disclose your information to protect the rights, property, or safety of our company, our users, or others, as required or permitted by law.
3. Information Sharing and Disclosure:

3.1 Third-Party Service Providers: We may engage trusted third-party service providers to assist us in delivering our services, analyzing data, processing payments, or hosting our website. These providers are obligated to maintain the confidentiality and security of your personal information and are restricted from using it for any other purpose.

3.2 Business Transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our company assets, your personal information may be transferred as part of the transaction. We will notify you of any such change and provide you with choices regarding your information.
3.3 Legal Requirements: We may disclose your personal information if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities (e.g., a court or government agency).
4. Data Security:

We implement reasonable security measures to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of your personal information. However, please note that no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure. We cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.
5. Children’s Privacy:
Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect

personal information from children without appropriate parental consent. If you believe we may have collected information from a child without parental consent, please contact us, and we will promptly remove the information.
6. International Data Transfers:

If you are accessing our services from outside the [country where the company is based], please be aware that your personal information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in [country where the company is based]. By using our services, you consent to the transfer and processing of your information in [country where the company is based].
7. Your Rights and Choices:

You have the right to access, update, correct, and delete your personal information. You may also have the right to restrict or object to the processing of your information and to receive a copy of your information in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format. To exercise these rights or for any privacy-related inquiries, please contact us using the information provided below.
8. Changes to this Privacy Policy:

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal obligations. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated Privacy Policy on our website and updating the “Last Updated” date at the top. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically.
9. Contact Us:
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at support@angelcreations.in.

By using our website and services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to the collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information as described herein.
